text: いいな　いいな　ガルーラの　こどもの　みがわりに　なって　あの　おなかの　ふくろに　はいって　みたいな！

structure.jp: ガルーラの　こどもの　みがわりに　なって
structure.en: taking the place of Kangaskhan's child

structure.jp: あの　おなかの　ふくろに
はいって　みたいな！
structure.en: I'd like to try getting in!

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: はいって　みたいな
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-form verb means 'try doing it to see what it is like'; here it has たい 'want to' and a musing な added. はいって　みたいな = 'I'd love to try getting in'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb says the speaker wants to do it; this is みる plus たい, not the みたい that means 'looks like'. はいって　みたい = 'want to try getting in'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.span: みがわりに　なって
patterns.explanation: になる after a thing word says someone turns into that; the て-form then leads on to the next action. みがわりに　なって = 'becoming the stand-in, and'.
